Too small for a big family

items.stemEn: The ____ of this jacket feels soft and warm.
items.stemZh: 這件夾克的布料摸起來又軟又暖。

items.stemEn: I'm going to the ____ to get my hair cut this afternoon.
items.stemZh: 我今天下午要去美髮店剪頭髮。

items.passageEn: Last month, I visited a small clothing factory in my hometown. The owner showed me how they choose each fabric: they pull hard on every fiber to test its strength. The factory makes elegant outfits for office workers, but its best-selling product is a dress with a soft belt at the waist. Visitors must wear a badge, and photos are not allowed. At the end of the tour, I tried on a costume they had made for a local theater, and everyone laughed. The owner said many hair salons in the city also order uniforms from them.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我參觀了家鄉一間小型成衣工廠。老闆示範他們如何挑選布料：用力拉扯每一根纖維，測試它的強度。工廠為上班族製作高雅的套裝，但最暢銷的是一款腰間繫著柔軟腰帶的洋裝。參觀者必須配戴識別證，而且不准拍照。參觀結束時，我試穿了他們為當地劇場做的一套戲服，大家都笑了。老闆說，市區很多美髮沙龍也向他們訂製制服。

options: 用力拉扯纖維測試強度
把布料先用水仔細洗過一次
讓老顧客一起投票來決定

questions.questionZh: 參觀結束時，作者做了什麼？
options: 買了一件有腰帶的洋裝

referenceEn: This skirt is too tight around the waist.
The waist of this skirt is too tight.
rubricZh: waist 指「腰部」（例如 around the waist、the waist of…）

items.instructionZh: 用 costume 造一個句子，說說你或家人穿戲服或變裝的經驗。
referenceEn: My daughter wore a princess costume to her friend's birthday party.
I dressed up in a cat costume for a Halloween party last year.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 costume（例如 wear a … costume、in a … costume）
句子要說到你或你的家人
